title: Supervisor single-path cleanup: queue-intent task read, remove dead dirty-PR review hold, honour superseded native auth markers

docs_evidence.note: measured before this evidence file was added; evidence.json itself adds under 400 lines

changes.build_request: reads the task only from metadata.task; _queue_delivery_event_locked is the single writer of queue intents (live state: 204 records, 0 top-level task, 204 metadata.task).
changes.dirty_pr_hold_removed: OPS-REVIEW-DISPATCH-DIRTY-PR-HOLD-001 removed from supervisor.py and worker_runner.py. It keyed on task['review_binding'], which a review-status task never carries: handoff pops review_binding and only approve and operator_accept write it. The hold therefore always failed open; the activity log and 4,048 archives hold 0 worker_review_pr_dirty_hold events. Removing it changes no runtime behaviour. The review flow does NOT handle a DIRTY PR: reviewer reopen is refused by admission revalidation and blocker is owner-only. That gap is a separate operator decision and out of scope.
changes.kept: a037cc53c blocker responsibility transfer (RESPONSIBILITY_TRANSFER_EVENT_TYPES, canonical_worker_terminal_status) and #6221 _set_pending_wait_reason; only two docstrings of the blocker tests changed, bodies untouched.
changes.native_log_failure: scan stays newest to oldest; an auth marker older than a line with 'authenticated successfully' and no auth marker is skipped; quota markers never skipped; marker strings unchanged (split into NATIVE_LOG_QUOTA_MARKERS and NATIVE_LOG_AUTH_MARKERS). Reference semantics: provider_permissions._antigravity_probe_ready, not imported or edited.
changes.stale_probe_vectors: Four (0,'OK','OK',native,'not_logged_in') vectors of test_native_auth_lifecycle_preserves_terminal_and_model_failures have been red since #5871 (546a9cf01, 2026-09-17), a deliberate behaviour change that made non-empty model output decisive (see test_antigravity_probe_ready_trusts_model_output_over_trailing_native_marker). They are stale expectations, not a regression. Fixed by giving each empty stdout and empty output; native input and expected not_logged_in unchanged; test_provider_permissions.py not edited.

pytest_head.command: PANTHEON_STATUS_ROOT=<coordination root> $PANTHEON_DEPENDENCY_PYTHON -m pytest -q (from repo root) .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py test_worker_runner.py test_worker_runner_heartbeat.py test_antigravity_error_observability.py test_provider_permissions.py rewrite/test_worker_recovery.py

validation.red_on_base: With the unmodified base supervisor.py, test_native_log_auth_marker_superseded_by_later_success_is_not_a_failure fails (returns 'You are not logged into Antigravity.'); the two guard cases and all other observability tests pass (1 failed, 15 passed).
validation.base_failures: Full six-file run was not repeated on the base; head has no failures, so there is no new failure and no base-only failure to name.

operator_follow_up: Runtime promotion (not run by this delivery; no sync-dev-root.sh).
Decide separately how a reviewer should handle a DIRTY PR.
